recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot studio portrait of a male figure with voluminous 80s-style hair, wearing a white dress shirt, suspenders, and a distressed brown leather jacket draped over one shoulder. The lighting is soft and directional, set against a smooth purple-to-grey gradient background with a slight film grain texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the crisp white shirt and the rugged texture of the leather jacket.
The subject's direct gaze creates a focal point against the soft-focus background.
The verticality of the suspenders and shirt opening echoes the condensed letterforms of the typography.
coreInvariants: Purple-to-grey radial or linear gradient background.
Soft-focus studio lighting with warm skin tones.
Distressed leather texture on the outer garment.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, captured from the waist up, filling approximately 75% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes serve as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead to the bold typography in the top right, then down the vertical lines of the shirt and suspenders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper left and right corners to accommodate text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted purple and grey gradient background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the dress shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm ochre and brown tones in the leather jacket and skin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with a soft, high-key value range in the shirt and face.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon colors; stick to muted 80s pastels and earth tones.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in negative space above the shoulder

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for display; small technical metadata in a similar condensed sans at the bottom.
graphicDevices: Small white rectangular border for secondary logo/metadata area in bottom right.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Offers the tall, narrow proportions seen in the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with 1980s wavy hair, wearing a white button-down shirt with suspenders and a worn brown leather jacket over one shoulder. Background is a soft purple to grey gradient. Soft lighting, film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in the top right corner using an extra-condensed bold white sans-serif font. Add a small white box in the bottom right corner containing small technical text and a simple geometric logo.

verificationChecks: Is the font extra-condensed and uppercase?
Is the background a smooth purple-grey gradient?
Does the leather jacket have a visible distressed texture?
Is the lighting soft and reminiscent of 80s studio photography?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white shirt is not blown out (losing detail).
Verify the typography is aligned to the right margin.
Confirm the jacket texture looks like real leather.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a soft-lit studio portrait with 80s styling + apply a purple-grey gradient background + overlay extra-condensed bold white sans-serif text in the top right corner.
